entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: A 5GS mobility management message used by the network to initiate network slice-specific authentication with the UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol being used for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the type of security header applied to the message.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information identifying the network slice for which authentication is being performed.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Contains Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) payload for the authentication procedure.

relations.description: The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes the Security header type IE.
The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes the Spare half octet IE.
The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes its message identity IE.
The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes the S-NSSAI IE.
The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message includes the EAP message IE.
